title: Bethlen István és a konszolidáció (Stabilization, League of Nations & Pengő)
grammar: Institutional Participles (-andó/-endő), Instrumentality Connectors & Historical Discourse

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can understand and discuss Stabilization, League of Nations & Pengő in interwar Hungarian history.
I can say by what means something was achieved, with révén, útján and által.
I can say what the Bethlen government achieved in the 1920s.
I can use six words about the 1920s consolidation, such as pengő and Népszövetség.
